payload.text: Router label: WAN MAC 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E, please mask before sharing screenshots.
Switch inventory record uses MAC 00-1A-2B-3C-4D-5E for the uplink port sticker.
The device supports dual-band Wi-Fi 6, two LAN ports, and Bluetooth pairing for setup.
Debug hash 001A2B3C4D5E was copied from a firmware checksum field and is not a MAC address.
Malformed value 00:1A-2B:3C-4D:5E should stay unchanged because the separators are inconsistent.
IPv6 sample fe80::1a2b:3c4d:5e6f:7080 must not be treated as a MAC address.
